posts.title: A Cheating Empire
posts.description: It goes without saying that, at 16 years old, I was young and stupid. I had just graduated high school, and I had no idea what I wanted to do with my life. My neighbor – let’s call him Adam – who was 19 at the time and had a car, was in his second year of Electrical Engineering. Naturally, I idolized my older, cooler neighbor, and imitated him by also enrolling in E.E..
